skills.description: Kubernetes cluster operations gap audit — /kubegap [daily|full|setup|focus <area>|explain <finding-id>] [--context <name>] [--namespace <ns>] [--snapshot <date>] [--compare <A> <B>]. Collects, summarizes and first-pass evaluates the cluster of the current kube context, then the LLM analyzes the result and writes a Markdown report. daily (default) is a short run compared with the previous daily run; full collects everything and writes the full report; setup only asks the first-run questions again.
